title: A dimension read off the drawing beats the estimate
rule: faceToFace روی گره همیشه بر تخمین od×0.62 مقدم است
note: od*0.62 approximates B16.9 overall length H to within a couple of millimetres at NPS 12 and drifts about 10% at the extremes, so a drawing that dimensions the reducer should be believed instead.
